title: Combined-Program Credit Addition for Households with Several Children in Creek Kids Club
content:
**Schedule.** Under the multi-program household schedule of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, the combined-program credit of a tuition-based Pre-K child has an amount added by the number of the household's children holding a Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program enrollment in status active. Each such enrollment covers one child.

| Children of the household holding a Creek Kids Club enrollment in status active | Added to the combined-program credit |
|---|---|
| three or more | 15.00 |
| exactly two | 10.00 |
| one or none | nothing |

Every active Creek Kids Club enrollment of the household counts, whatever the plan (After-School Care, Before-School Care, Before & After-School Care or Pre-K Wraparound Care). A registration that is waitlisted or not yet active does not count.

## Examples (hypothetical households)

- A household has its Pre-K child in active Pre-K Wraparound Care and two older children in active Before-School Care: three children, so 15.00 is added.
- A household has twins, both in active Pre-K Wraparound Care, and no other child in Creek Kids Club: two children, so 10.00 is added.
- A household has only its Pre-K child in Creek Kids Club: nothing is added.
